sources.title: XCTest / Swift Core Libraries
sources.confirmed: The dated launch post identifies the open source Core Libraries project, including XCTest, and states the goal of consistent functionality across platforms.
sources.limits: The 2015 launch establishes the project's availability, not platform completeness or the exact APIs in the live XCTestMain.swift source; toolchain and platform compatibility need checking. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: Cargo test command and configurable test harness
sources.sections_read: Description; harness selection; documentation tests; compile-only and failure options
sources.confirmed: Cargo compiles and executes unit, integration, and documentation tests through a package command. It supports a default harness and custom main entry points when the harness is disabled.
sources.limits: Rust compiler attributes and rustdoc cannot be reused directly for Swift; the retrieved live documentation does not establish which details were available by the cutoff. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: Go's integrated build, test, and install tool
sources.sections_read: Go 1 history; How to build; The go tool; remote repositories (find on 'go test')
sources.confirmed: The 2012 talk describes go as a combined build, test, and install tool, and shows go test compiling and executing a package's unit tests. It also describes transitive remote dependency installation.
sources.limits: Go's source and dependency conventions require translation to Swift; the example is an orchestration precedent, not a Swift testing implementation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: CTest and CMake add_test
sources.version_or_date: CMake 3.0.2 documentation, paired with the 2014-09-11 release announcement
sources.confirmed: CMake's add_test registers a named command, optional configuration, and working directory for CTest; executable target names are resolved to the built program. Testing can be enabled through the CTest module.
sources.limits: CTest is a build/test tool rather than a Swift dependency manager; a package adapter must still arrange compilation and dependencies. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: XCTestMain.swift
sources.sections_read: XCTMain runner implementations and process exit status; test selection and listing command help
sources.confirmed: The live public source runs a root test suite, notifies observers, and maps total failures to success or failure exit codes; it supports selecting or listing test cases. The exact historical availability of this implementation was not established.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: Test Anything Protocol (TAP)
sources.confirmed: TAP defines a text stream separating test results from their presentation, allowing producers and consumers written in different languages to interoperate.
sources.limits: A reporting protocol does not discover, compile, or execute tests; adapters must preserve failures and diagnostics, and the retrieved live overview was not dated to the cutoff. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: Maven Surefire lifecycle integration
sources.version_or_date: Live documentation with 3.6.x navigation; no publication date displayed
sources.sections_read: Test-phase execution; goals overview; plain-text and XML reporting
sources.confirmed: Surefire runs unit tests in Maven's test lifecycle phase and writes text and XML reports. This offers a reference for connecting tests and machine-readable outcomes to a packaging lifecycle.
sources.limits: Surefire targets JVM applications; its lifecycle and reporting ideas need adaptation, and the live page's historical availability was not verified. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.

sources.title: npm test and package-defined test scripts
sources.sections_read: Synopsis; description; version and last-edited metadata
sources.confirmed: npm test delegates to a package-defined test script and accepts arguments. The retrieved v6 documentation explicitly shows a last-edited date of 2020-09-22.
sources.limits: Package scripts need explicit exit-status, environment, and portability rules; the retrieved documentation is later evidence and the public manifest example was not dated to the cutoff. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C25.json.
